prompt: Create one transparent PNG sprite atlas for a cozy Vietnamese-inspired chibi RPG kitchen yard. Exactly four clearly separated animation frames in one horizontal row, depicting the same small turquoise water glint and ripple in calm, lift, bright and settle poses. The effect should be subtle cyan-blue with a small warm reflected highlight, painterly pixel-like edges, and readable when rendered at 60x24 world units over an existing waterfall or pond. No pond, waterfall, fish, lotus, character, text, label, background, ground plane, border or cast shadow. Keep the motion calm and non-flashing so it reads as ambience rather than an interaction marker. Use generous fully transparent gutters between frames and around every outer edge, avoid cropping, preserve alpha transparency, and keep all four frame subjects isolated from one another. Match the water, flowers, stone and lantern palette of the supplied own-project Forgotten Kitchen Yard reference without copying any object from it.

references.role: own project kitchen-yard style and palette reference
